1.why: Clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable letter and line spacing appears on every screen.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: Centered card layout with short fields remains legible and well spaced at mobile width.

4.why: All instructions are brief sentences in plain language.

5.why: Recovery-code field shows example placeholder ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNPQ; demo account and test codes are also displayed.

6.why: No step forces the user to read a long block of text before continuing.

7.why: Setup secret and recovery codes are shown in selectable text boxes that can be copied, though no explicit copy button is present.

8.why: No QR code is offered; the flow only provides manual entry of the setup secret.

9.why: Ordinary input fields are used, but screenshots give no clear evidence of autofill attributes or password-manager support.

10.why: Clear step titles and prominent blue primary buttons make the current step and main action obvious.

11.why: Each screen requests only one primary action at a time.

12.why: Outcomes such as “MFA is active” and “Recovery code accepted” are stated plainly, though the next step is not always previewed.

13.why: Start again, Cancel setup, and Generate new recovery codes allow retries and re-requests without penalty.

14.why: Error text “We could not complete that request. Please try again.” does not explain the problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No reading time limit exists and SMS codes allow five minutes; TOTP entry is still bound to the usual short window.
